record.question: Ann and John got married last week.
record.explanation: Answer C: Adverb. The complete underlined phrase last week modifies got married and tells when. It functions as an adverbial of time; the offered traditional functional label is Adverb, although the target is a phrase rather than a single adverb. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/adverbs. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
record.direction: Directions (Questions 33 - 43): Point out the part of speech of the underlined words.
record.questionMarkup: Ann and John got married <u>last week</u>.
